pages.title: Wind Ripple
pages.text: §lMax Level: §r I$(br2)§lApplicable Items: §r Boots$(br2)§lEffect: §r Faster on land, and walk on water as if on flat ground. Conflicts with Depth Strider, Frost Walker, Soul Speed, and Swift Sneak.$(br2)§lAcquisition: §r Enchanting Table, Loot Chests, Villager Trades
